name: bash-log-rotation
taskDescription: Rotate and compress log files older than 7 days in /var/log/myapp, keeping 30 days of archives, with logging and a dry-run flag.

name: python-s3-backup
taskDescription: Back up a local directory to an S3 bucket using boto3, with retries, structured logging, and a --dry-run flag. Read the bucket name and prefix from environment variables.

name: powershell-disk-cleanup
taskDescription: Clean up temp files and the Windows temp directory on the local machine, report space reclaimed, support -WhatIf, and write a timestamped log file.

name: terraform-s3-bucket
taskDescription: Provision a private, versioned, server-side-encrypted S3 bucket with public access blocked, standard tags, and the region as a variable.
